scientific_scope: Uncertainty-aware multimodal computational framework for visible 3D wound reconstruction, sensor routing, failure detection, and conservative surface-conformal deposition planning.

source_manifest.role: Kaggle-compatible source code and embedded sealed records
Frozen TEST manifest, decision, and prediction hash receipt

dataset_table.origin: Public synthetic wound dataset, CSIRO Data Access Portal
dataset_table.modalities: Rendered RGB, shaded masks/labels, cropped meshes, COLMAP cameras/poses.
dataset_table.role: Primary source for RGB shape evaluation, mesh-rendered depth, sensor routing, calibration, hidden-disc and geometry studies.
dataset_table.sample_scope: 52 sequences inventoried; only explicitly listed subsets were evaluated. Sensor generalization used 4 sequence contexts and 252 correlated route/subset results.
dataset_table.limitations: No native depth maps or certified physical scale; local meshes are crops; synthetic renderer labels are not clinical truth.
dataset_table.safe_to_commit: No raw source data; download separately.

dataset_table.origin: Public silicone wound-phantom dataset and author-published reconstructions.
dataset_table.modalities: RGB video, camera transforms/intrinsics, scanner point cloud/GT, published aligned meshes.
dataset_table.role: Evaluation-only comparison of selected author-published reconstructions on the PIS4 Accuracy split.
dataset_table.sample_scope: 50 common frames from one phantom wound; 2,250 RGB/calibration/scanner-GT inputs and 102 published aligned outputs were acquired and inventoried.
dataset_table.limitations: GT similarity alignment is used; results evaluate shape only. Independent metric-scale recovery is not proven. The requested Seymour II acquisition is not available from the authors.
dataset_table.safe_to_commit: No raw source data or meshes; download separately.

dataset_table.origin: Public clinical wound-segmentation benchmark referenced by historical model code.
dataset_table.role: Not used as evidence in the completed reconstruction, sensor-routing, or safety results reported here.
dataset_table.sample_scope: No current-milestone evaluation count is claimed.
dataset_table.limitations: Legacy model components and notebook drafts do not establish clinical validation or generalization.

dataset_table.origin: Deterministic synthetic geometry and explicitly defined sensor corruptions.
dataset_table.modalities: Generated RGB, mesh-rendered depth, target surfaces, geometry and plan traces.
dataset_table.role: Five-case offline sensor-routing and staged-plan/update demonstration; separate 18-case final architecture decision.
dataset_table.sample_scope: 5 computational integration cases; 18 synthetic decision cases.
dataset_table.limitations: No physical camera, robot, CoppeliaSim, clinical data, or printing. Scene units are illustrative only.
dataset_table.safe_to_commit: Curated generated evidence may be committed; no raw external data.

clean_measurement.dominant_blocker: Counterfactual healthy reference/closure is unobserved, and healthy-ring model extrapolation over the wound is unstable. Perfect depth does not identify missing skin.

healthy_disc.interpretation: Lower-bound estimate of reference-surface extrapolation difficulty. Healthy discs omit swelling, wound-edge deformation, tissue loss, scar contraction, inflammation, and undermining; success does not recover pre-wound anatomy.
healthy_disc.physical_units: dataset units and declared synthetic layer fractions only

architecture_decision.body_model_scope: Synthetic carved wounds use two subject_2 healthy patches (arm and shoulder); no independent third body model is present.

coppeliasim.reason: No CoppeliaSim executable or installed runtime was present in the workspace.

salve_shape_only.interpretation: shape-only evaluation; independent metric scale NOT PROVEN
shape-only evaluation; independent metric scale NOT PROVEN

syn3dwound_rgb_shape.interpretation: Shape comparison after evaluation-only similarity alignment; not metric-scale recovery.

quantity_table.examples: Visible wound-bed surface, visible 3D boundary, local normals, visible area, support/confidence.
quantity_table.basis: RGB/depth or mesh observations, with their declared support and uncertainty.

quantity_table.examples: Depth relative to a declared reference, fill height, layer count, reference-defined volume.
quantity_table.basis: Requires an explicitly named and versioned reference surface or target policy.

statistical_audit.independent_unit: Dataset/model-specific sequence, body model, or frozen fault configuration—not pixels, views, patch-ring pairs, or repeated subsets.
statistical_audit.reason: Small numbers of independent wounds/body models and correlated views, subsets, patches, and fault variants do not justify population-level intervals.
percent_wound_width_metrics: misalignment offsets normalized by wound width when specified
physical_unit_metrics: SALVE point-to-surface millimeters only after GT similarity alignment; shape-only interpretation.
